class.name: RealityPortalCrossing3D
class.brief_description: Handles the rendering of its parent Node when crossing portals.
class.description:
This maps to RealityKit's [url=https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/PortalCrossingComponent]PortalCrossingComponent[/url].
Add a [b]RealityPortalCrossing3D[/b] under a Node when it crosses the shape of a [b]RealityPortalMeshInstance3D[/b].
